subject: swipe the strip labels from right to left in ggplot2

messages.author: bd6e26d77fbee35a
messages.subject: swipe the strip labels from right to left in ggplot2
parts:
Hi,

I wanted to generate a plot which is almost like the plot generated by
the following R codes.

n <- 15
category <- paste("Geographical Category", 1:n)
grp1 <- rnorm(n, mean=8, sd=10)
grp2 <- rnorm(n, mean=20, sd=10)
grp3 <- rnorm(n, mean=15, sd=10)
grp4 <- rnorm(n, mean=12, sd=10)


mydat <- data.frame(category,grp1,grp2,grp3,grp4)

dat.m <- melt(mydat)

p <- qplot(1,value, data=dat.m, geom="bar", xlab="",ylab="Percentage
of eco change",stat="identity",fill=variable, position="dodge")

p <- p + coord_flip()+ facet_grid(category ~ ., space="free")+
scale_x_discrete(breaks=c(1))+opts(strip.text.y =theme_text(hjust =
0) )
p + opts(strip.background = theme_rect(col=NA,fill=NA))

Now the only modification I need from this plot is that I want to
swipe the strip.labels (text) from right hand side to left hand side.
My prospective plot should have labels like the the plot generated by
the codes below. The reason why I don't like this plot below is that
it does not show separate grid for each category.

p <- qplot(category,value, data=dat.m, geom="bar", ylab="Percentage
of eco change",stat="identity",fill=variable, position="dodge")
p + coord_flip()


Can you help me generate my vision plot? I appreciate for your time on
this.

Mahbubul Majumder
Iowa State University
